items.title: Intraday LIVE-session reprice of BOTH the sector-RRG rotation state and the SPY dealer-gamma layer within one open session (pre-market -> morning, same calendar day 2026-08-03, market now OPEN) while the completed-equity-bar frontier stays frozen at 2026-07-31 - two normally-daily layers advance intra-session and persistence must NOT increment.
items.note: Genuinely new versus the prior 'weekend after-hours -> pre-market options-only reprice on an unadvanced bar' pattern. Three facts distinguish this run: (1) THE WINDOW ADVANCES WITHIN A SINGLE CALENDAR DAY and the SESSION IS NOW LIVE - snapshot.window pre-market -> morning, meta.todayEt unchanged at 2026-08-03, marketClosed=false, and intraday-tape-lab posts a live read (barsToday 13, VWAP 752.41, Trend day · up, gap +0.35%) rather than a carried completed-bar tape. (2) THE SECTOR RRG ADVANCES INTRA-SESSION on the same completed 07-31 bar: XLY moves Improving quad I (accel +0.9, ma200Dist -0.52, below 200d) -> Leading quad L (accel +1.81, ma200Dist +1.44, back above 200d, rsRatio 100.03, rsMom 101.46) while still bear-stacked and momentum-negative on all horizons - a live-price RRG reprice, not a new completed bar. (3) THE GAMMA LAYER REPRICES AGAIN on fresh 08-03 snapshots (22/22, updated 2026-08-03T14:30:48.435Z): spot 751.05 -> 753.98, call wall 752 -> 754, atmIV 6.57% -> 11.85% (nearly doubled) while expected move tightens ±3.65 -> ±3.31 on time decay, signedNetGEX +6.199B -> +6.439B, flip 742.49 -> 744.74. Meanwhile the completed-bar-anchored tools stay frozen on 07-31 (heatmap breadth 48.64% narrow, swing Bull-stacked, vol-sizing 13.9101% throttle ×1.08) and the bench/regime layer moves only intraday (SPY 747.03 -> 754.41; VIX 15.95 -> 15.88, band 'VIX 15.9'). Signature: a same-day window rollover into an OPEN session can advance the intraday tape, flip an RRG quadrant, and reprice the gamma structure all at once, yet none of it is a new completed daily bar - so persistence must hold.
items.method: Extend the off-hours-carry detector with an 'intra-session live-reprice on a frozen completed-bar frontier' test that fires when snapshot.window advances within the SAME meta.todayEt AND marketClosed=false AND an intraday tape read is live AND either the sector-RRG quadrant OR the gamma-structure levels move materially while dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate is unchanged. Trigger on SIX tests: (1) SAME-DAY WINDOW ADVANCE = snapshot.window changes (pre-market -> morning) with meta.todayEt unchanged (2026-08-03) and marketClosed=false; (2) LIVE INTRADAY TAPE = intraday-tape metrics have barsToday > 0 (13) and a live VWAP (752.41) rather than a carried completed-session tape; (3) EQUITY BAR FRONTIER UNCHANGED = dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate still 2026-07-31 with freshSymbolCount == symbolCount and carriedSymbolCount == 0 and missingSymbolCount == 0 (287/287, 0, 0) - a live same-bar re-price, NOT an append; (4) RRG QUADRANT FLIP INTRA-SESSION = sector into-leg quad/rrgState/accel/ma200Dist change (XLY I->L, accel 0.9->1.81, ma200Dist -0.52->+1.44) while maStack stays bear-stack and RS-momentum stays negative; (5) MATERIAL GAMMA REPRICE = spot / callWall / atmIV / expectedMove / signedNetGEX / flip move versus the prior window (spot 751.05->753.98, callWall 752->754, atmIV 0.0657->0.1185, EM 3.65->3.31, GEX +6.199B->+6.439B, flip 742.49->744.74); (6) PERSISTENCE MUST NOT INCREMENT = because no NEW distinct completed bar date exists, distinct-bar counts hold (XLY rotate-into stays early-persistent across [2026-07-30, 2026-07-31] = 2; the structural tools stay at 1 = [2026-07-31]). HARD RULE: count persistence by DISTINCT completed market-bar dates only - a same-day window advance, a live intraday session, an RRG quadrant flip, and an options-only reprice NEVER increment the counter; only a new distinct completed daily bar does.
